description: email.rs:692-696: build_email_from_create stores the entire HashMap<Keyword,bool> including false-valued entries. RFC 8621 §5.5.3: 'The value for each key in the object MUST be true.' Import handler correctly filters with .filter(|(_, v)| *v) but create does not. Client sending {"$seen": false} would see the keyword stored in the email and returned on get. Fix: filter to only true values, same as import path (email.rs:945-949).
title: Email/set create: keywords with false values stored verbatim
